newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Key Technology downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Key Technology downgraded.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Wednesday it downgraded Key Technology Inc to hold in light of a disappointing product mix that will result in a loss in the first quarter of 1997.

-- Dain analyst Reid Dabney said Key Technology announced late yesterday it would report a loss of between $0.15 and $0.18 a share in the first quarter. Dabney had expected to see a profit of $0.09 a share in the period.

-- Key Technology's surprisingly high revenues of $13.4 million in the second quarter were heavily weighted toward the company's lower-margin products, Dabney said, pulling down gross margins below anticipated levels.
-- Dabney lowered his estimate for the fourth quarter to a loss of $0.17, reduced the estimate for the second quarter to $0.20 from $0.28 and revised the full-year estimate to $1.00 from $1.28.
-- Key Technology makes automated food processing systems.
-- Its shares were trading off six Wednesday at 18-3/4.
